overall: The AG found the Department's Healthcare Associated Infection/Antibiotic Resistance Technical Advisory Group is not a public body under the OML because it is not empowered to act collectively, so it could not have violated the Law and no remedy was ordered.

allegations.summary: Complaint said the Department's HAI/Antibiotic Resistance advisory group violated the OML, including by not providing meeting minutes.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Group does not satisfy all three factors, as outlined above, we find that it is not a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law.
